check: whether header.json's empty farSegments array means the MIXED_24H profile omitted its far-jump component
why: The profile is documented as rotating walk, far jump and re-entry into generated regions. farSegments is the field named after the far-jump component, and it is empty in the header - which would read as a missing third of the workload.
itIsEmptyByConstruction: StressFixture builds the Config with List.of() passed literally for farSegments, on the line that also fixes the mode to MIXED_24H. So the empty array records what was configured, not something that failed to populate.
andNothingReadsItInThisMode: farSegments is read in exactly one place, generatePositions' FAR_JUMP case, which is not the mode in use. It appears three other times: the record component, a defensive copy, and the header write.

theFarJumpComponentIsImplementedInsideMI.theBranch: MIXED_24H fills MAX_PENDING positions with a deterministic rotation on i mod 3
theFarJumpComponentIsImplementedInsideMI.case1: ChunkPos((i % 500) * 2048, 1) - 2048-chunk jumps, which is the far jump
theFarJumpComponentIsImplementedInsideMI.soTheRotationIsComplete: All three components are present, the far jump being the 2048-block stride rather than a list of segments

whatARecordCheckWouldHaveConcludedWrongl: Comparing farSegments against a non-empty expectation would have reported a missing component. The field is simply a different mode's input.
